name: Visa de Migrante (M) -- Pensionado o Rentista

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a lifetime pension (or, for the rentista variant, other passive income) of at least 3 SMLMV/month (Colombia's legal monthly minimum wage unit -- approximately USD 1,382 at the source's implied conversion rate; the real legal threshold is denominated in SMLMV and drifts annually), from a government, publicly-held, or private pension source.
requirements.fix_path: Document a qualifying lifetime pension or passive income of at least 3 SMLMV/month.

evidence_required.document: Pension certification letter (monthly amount, no less than 3 SMLMV)
Health insurance covering all risks and repatriation
Criminal background check from the country of prior residence (last 3 years)

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years; holder must visit Colombia at least once every 180 days to keep the visa valid

sources.title: ColombiaVisas.com (immigration consultancy) -- Colombia M-Pensionado visa: 3 SMLMV income requirement, documents, 5-year path to PR

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Colombia's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: cancilleria.gov.co's own pensioner page (cancilleria.gov.co/v/pensionado) and the Miami consulate's page both returned errors (404) to automated fetching in this pass, so the 3 SMLMV figure is only tier-3 confirmed. The category's existence is confirmed at tier-1 (listed among the 14 M sub-categories on cancilleria.gov.co/node/26933). work_rights explicitly 'none' per the tier-3 source -- this visa does not permit employment. Colombia has NO distinct, separately-legislated 'digital nomad' visa category as of this research pass -- remote workers commonly use this Rentista sub-category or the Independent Professional M sub-category instead; not modelled as its own route to avoid inventing a category that does not exist in Colombian law.
